public_rationale: The June 3, 2023 research demonstrated training-data influence analysis using specially trained diffusion-model ensembles [e1]. GitHub's November 30, 2023 public beta provided references to public code matching Copilot suggestions [e2]. Neither demonstrates reliable training-source attribution in deployed DALL-E or ChatGPT systems as of December 29, 2023 [e1, e2]. Neither establishes that technical inability caused missing attribution, so the causal claim remains unresolved [e1, e2].
limitations: The ensemble demonstration does not establish the capability of contemporary deployed DALL-E or ChatGPT systems [e1].
Matching public code establishes similarity, not which training examples influenced an output [e2].
Neither item explains why the systems discussed lacked training-source attribution [e1, e2].

statement.excerpt: GenAI systems don’t give attribution to source materials because at least as constituted now, they can’t.
statement.document_title: Things are about to get a lot worse for Generative AI

our_interpretation: In this discussion of training materials and provenance, attribution means reliably identifying the training sources behind an output. Merely citing a retrieved webpage or labeling an image AI-generated does not establish that capability.
The claim asserts that technical inability explains missing attribution. Missing product features alone cannot establish that cause.
A limited research demonstration or matching service bears against an absolute impossibility claim, but does not necessarily establish reliable attribution in deployed systems.
criteria.support_condition: Technical evidence establishes that contemporary deployed systems could not reliably identify the training sources behind their outputs, and that this limitation explains their failure to provide attribution.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A contemporary deployed system demonstrably provides reliable training-source attribution, or technical evidence establishes that the claimed inability was not the reason attribution was absent.
